verdict.rationale: No documented bulk export or data-portability feature appears in the evidence. PayPal does expose read access to core merchant data through REST APIs and agent tools, including list_transaction, list_invoices, list_disputes, list_product and get_merchant_insights, so a user could script retrieval of much of their data in JSON. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export or download feature, explicit open-format exports (CSV/JSON archives), coverage of all account data (e.g., consumer/personal data, history), account-closure/offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration.
